newsitem.title: UK: Newman Tonks says had approaches for unit.
newsitem.headline: Newman Tonks says had approaches for unit.

text.p: Newman Tonks Group Plc, facing a hostile bid from engineering group FKI Plc, said on Tuesday that it had received "unsolicited approaches" for one of its units Shapland & Petter, which were rejected.

In a statement, Newman Tonks said "The board has reviewed these approaches and has decided not to pursue them. The company is not in discussions to sell Shapland & Petter and has no current intention to sell the business."

The board also said, in response to press speculation, that "a profit estimate and dividend forecast will be released in due course" and refused to elaborate further. The group said the speculation should be disregarded.
It currently faces a takeover play from FKI which has received aceptances for 20.45 percent of its target's shareholding.
Newman Tonks, a building equipment group, is expected to be unsuccessful in its efforts to fight off the unwanted suitor which is making a 195.7 million stg bid.
